description: Structured wireframe specification for product UI screens, designed to be easily converted into Excalidraw or other diagram formats.

screens.description: List of wireframe screens in the product experience.

id.description: Stable slug-style identifier for the screen.

goal.description: Concise description of what the user accomplishes on this screen.

user_flow_step.description: Optional reference to the user flow step or scenario this screen belongs to.

layout_hint.description: High-level layout pattern (e.g. single-column, two-column, sidebar-layout).

elements.description: UI elements that make up this screen.

type.description: Element type (e.g. button, input, textarea, card, list, modal, image-placeholder, navbar, tab, checkbox, radio-group).

label.description: Short, descriptive label for the element.

x.description: Horizontal grid position on a normalized 12-column grid.

y.description: Vertical grid position on a normalized 12-row grid.

state.description: Optional state hint (e.g. default, disabled, error, success, hover).

notes.description: Optional short notes for behavior or constraints that are not obvious from other fields.

INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.description: When present, describes missing inputs that block wireframe generation.

missing_screens.description: Names or identifiers of screens that cannot be safely specified.

assumptions_required.description: Assumptions that would be necessary to proceed if a human approves them.
